page: Vultr vcg-l40s-16c-180g-48vram is a Cloud GPU server configured with an Intel Xeon 6448H processor featuring 16 dedicated physical cores running at 2.0 GHz. The system includes 180.0 GB of system memory, providing 11.25 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via a single NVIDIA L40S GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, equipped with 48 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 1200 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in specific workloads, particularly LLM inference. For a 7B parameter model, prompt processing reaches 6293.73 tokens per second, and text generation achieves 153.1 tokens per second, both placing in the top 10% tier. Single-threaded bzip3 decompression also ranks in the top 10% at 15.59 GB/sec. General CPU and memory benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core (34834.61) and Passmark CPU (40930.36), fall within the average range.

This server offers high qualitative cost efficiency for GPU-accelerated tasks due to the high density of VRAM relative to the 16 vCPU allocation. The combination of dedicated Intel Xeon cores, a fast NVMe SSD, and Ada Lovelace GPU architecture makes this configuration highly suitable for medium-scale LLM inference, data science, and GPU-accelerated database operations.
